content:

From 47-50 Sts-Rockefeller Ctr, take the D or F train south one stop to 34 St-Herald Sq. There, transfer within the station to the N, Q, or R train, which runs north directly to Times Sq-42 St. This is two station stops (34 St-Herald Sq, then Times Sq-42 St).

The alternative through 59 St-Columbus Circle (D, then transfer to the 1 train) also has one transfer but takes three stops, so it is longer.

FINAL ANSWER: 34 St-Herald Sq
